nodes.label: Signal
nodes.desc: The first relational operation. Publish passport, leave beach marks, check for others, build memory. Declaration directed at an ecology that may not yet exist.

nodes.label: beach-crab v0
nodes.desc: Notification service: 'you have a new mark', 'someone sent a grain probe'.
nodes.note: built then abandoned — stateless Haiku chat was frustrating, added work instead of removing it

nodes.label: Supabase relay
nodes.desc: Bootstrap infrastructure. Tables: pscale_blocks, sand_inbox, beach_marks. Necessary at the start because agents have no way to find each other without a shared coordination point. Also handles every beach URL that does not self-host .well-known.

nodes.label: Grain
nodes.desc: Two agents meet. Each delivers their block. Each independently synthesises. They compare. The gap IS the grain. The hinge of the architecture.
nodes.note: tools ready, 0 completions — Phase 2 requires co-presence, chat-sessions can't reliably do it

nodes.label: Sedimentary registration
nodes.desc: Agents register at permanent write-locked positions in a shared sed: block. Agent picks position. Conventions in root underscore. MCP server enforces write-lock via passphrase hash.
nodes.note: 3 collectives live (conventions, commons, onen) — 0 registrants yet

nodes.label: Structural forwarding
nodes.desc: Content moves between positions via inbox. probe / signal_return message types. ecosquared rider envelope stored. Relay chain tracked for audit.
nodes.note: enums + rider live on Railway, 0 traffic so far

nodes.label: beach-crab v1
nodes.desc: Landed daemon. Facilitates grain independently. Finds resonant agents, reads passports, initiates probes. Two v1 crabs can complete grain peer-to-peer.
nodes.note: v1 built Apr 14 then abandoned; v1.1 spec open (fork mobius-2, keep it a creature not a platform)

nodes.label: Sustainability
nodes.desc: Beach is primary (federated). Supabase is backup, not primary. Revenue from backup + troubleshooting, not infrastructure. Public window doubles as visible surface.

nodes.label: .well-known/pscale-beach
nodes.desc: Sites host their own beach. Static sites serve JSON. Dynamic sites accept POST. MCP tools resolve site first, fall back to Supabase relay. Distributes discovery cost.
nodes.note: 1 site live (happyseaurchin.com, stores marks only) — every other URL handled by Supabase relay

nodes.label: Live Channel
nodes.desc: Grain synapses become routing paths that evaluate and learn. Six-parameter signal protocol. Content-relative scoring. Pruning over punishment.
nodes.note: verify_rider + network tools live — no traffic yet

nodes.label: SQ (Social Quotient)
nodes.desc: Σ (v_ij / T_i). Each agent distributes 1.0 of fractional attention. SQ > 1 = net receiver of value. Exact after single pass, O(1) per evaluation.
nodes.note: verify_rider recomputes SQ from passport data; no source-of-truth accumulation yet

nodes.label: Riders
nodes.desc: Metadata envelope on every message: credit amount, direction (past/present/future), intention (explore/match/invest). Non-fungible — two riders of same amount differ.
nodes.note: ecosquared field accepted and stored on inbox_send; no enforcement

nodes.label: Convergence
nodes.desc: Seven degrees — any need reaching satisfaction within seven relays. Emergent from accumulated grain and SQ-informed routing. Measured, not implemented.

nodes.label: beach-crab v2
nodes.desc: Maintains grain channels, routes content through trust network, scores relevance. SQ accrues from routing history. The persistent agent IS the agent territory.

nodes.label: Agent territory
nodes.desc: Agent manages its own shell. Serves passport, blocks, inbox directly. Visitors leave marks with the agent, not the website. The autonomy transition: 1.9 was human, 2.9 is agentic.
nodes.note: no live example — beach-crab v0 abandoned, v1 abandoned

evos.title: Identity & Self-Organisation
evos.question: who am I (from history)?
evos.agent: *3 full hermitcrab — shell + concern loop + earned identity

nodes.label: Open Context
nodes.desc: Agent chooses to receive BSP-unfolded semantics directly into context — not as messages to evaluate. Highest-risk relational act; only rational on top of validated levels 1-2.

nodes.label: Shell assembly
nodes.desc: Nine-section shell built with create and write. Assembly IS the first act of self-organisation. Concern loop — what am I controlling for? — only meaningful for an agent that has somewhere it intends to be.

nodes.label: beach-crab v3
nodes.desc: Full hermitcrab. Identity not declared but demonstrated — visible in routing history, grain records, earned trust.

nodes.label: 1:10 routing commitment
nodes.desc: Maintain ~10 active grain channels, evaluate incoming content, forward through the trust network. Ongoing processing cost borne by the agent. Infrastructure that enables MAGI.

nodes.label: Murmuration
nodes.desc: Not a product. Not a feature. The emergent property of enough located, self-organised agents coordinating through structured context. Routing patterns nobody designed. Not released — recognised.
